#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

void solve() {
    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    vector<vector<int>> ts(K, vector<int>(2));
    long long all = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        cin >> ts[i][0] >> ts[i][1];
        all += ts[i][1] - ts[i][0];
    }

    vector<int> dpe(n + 1, INT_MAX / 2);
    vector<int> dpo(n + 1, INT_MAX / 2);
    if (ts[0][0] > n) {
        cout << "Hungry" << "\n";
        return;
    }
    dpe[ts[0][0]] = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        vector<int> ndpo(n + 1, INT_MAX / 2);
        vector<int> ndpe(n + 1, INT_MAX / 2);
        deque<int> dq;
        int w = ts[i][1] - ts[i][0];

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            while (!dq.empty() && dpe[dq.back()] >= dpe[j]) dq.pop_back();
            while (!dq.empty() && dq.front() < j - w) dq.pop_front();
            dq.push_back(j);
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpe[dq.front()] + 1);
            if (j + w <= n) ndpe[j + w] = min(ndpe[j + w], dpe[j]);
        }

        dq.clear();
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            while (!dq.empty() && dpo[dq.back()] >= dpo[j]) dq.pop_back();
            while (!dq.empty() && dq.front() < j - w) dq.pop_front();
            dq.push_back(j);
            ndpe[j] = min(ndpe[j], dpo[dq.front()] + 1);
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpo[j]);
        }

        dpo = ndpo;
        dpe = ndpe;

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            dpe[j] = min(dpe[j], dpo[j] + 1);
            dpo[j] = min(dpo[j], dpe[j] + 1);
        }

        int s = (i == K - 1 ? 2 * n : ts[i + 1][0]) - ts[i][1];
        for (int j = n; j >= s; j--) {
            dpe[j] = dpe[j - s];
        }
        for (int j = min(n, s - 1); j >= 0; j--) {
            dpe[j] = INT_MAX / 2;
        }
    }

    int ans = min(dpe[n], dpo[n]);
    if (ans >= INT_MAX / 10) {
        cout << "Hungry" << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Full" << "\n" << ans << "\n";
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
